parakeet: The only authority you need is your own conviction. Now, over this journey, we've torn down the myths that bound us. No more blaming unseen forces for our failures, waiting on divine downloads for our finances, health, relationships, or we replaced spiritual footnotes with human agency. We found relief and responsibility without supernatural rescue. We reclaimed our own plans when cosmic authorship faded. We celebrated failure as fuel and freed our reasoning from the mystical veto. We mastered money with math, health, with habits, connections with intention, and legacies with purpose. This is more than theory. It's a roadmap to owning your life. You don't need permission from heaven or history's heroes. The only authority you need is your own conviction. Let this be the moment you pick up the pen and write your next chapter. You've done the work. Now live it.
